We've already looked at DLSS 4.5 "Preset M", designed for 4K performance mode upscaling - but what about the more demanding "Preset L". This one's even more computationally expensive and best used on 40-series and 50-series GPUs. It's also meant for 3x3 upscaling - 4K from a base 720p, effectively. Alex takes a look at how Preset L compares to Preset M and older DLSS versions, then takes a look at 1440p performance - can upscaling from a base 480p to 1440p benefit older RTX graphics cards?
